The ''' 23rd Combat Starfighter Wing''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] wing that belonged to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]]. It was composed of [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] and [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] starfighters. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the 23rd Combat Starfighter Wing took part in the [[Battle of Mindor]].<ref name="som" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''
